node: Transmission line hardware for AI/data-center grid buildout
summary: Layer 1B expansion for the transmission-line-hardware node finds one unusually direct underfollowed public candidate, PLPC, plus larger reference or adjacent names. The strongest direct-node mapping is Preformed Line Products, which sells line hardware and reported rising backlog. Hubbell is the larger reference product leader in utility T&D components. MYR Group is a smaller downstream transmission contractor whose project activity can be used as a demand signal for upstream hardware procurement. Valmont is an adjacent infrastructure supplier through transmission structures, not line hardware itself, so it is included as a second-order asset/hardware-adjacent comp rather than a pure node match.
